input.command:
uname -a; hostname; cat /proc/1/comm 2>/dev/null; (test -r /proc/cmdline && tr ' ' '
' </proc/cmdline | head -20); printf '%s
' 'LITEBOX_LOCAL_OK' > /workspace/litebox-marker.txt; cat /workspace/litebox-marker.txt; printf '%s
' 'LITEBOX_LOCAL_OK' > /mnt/session/outputs/litebox-marker.txt 2>/dev/null || true
